info.description: No email delivery, linking or token URLs. Tokens are accepted only in HTTPS POST JSON bodies. Linking and credential lifecycle remain unfinished.
info.title: Invitation contracts — ID-B/B2

post.description: Current human session only. Mutations require recent actual authentication, exact Origin and session CSRF. No bearer or mixed credentials. Creation/list/revoke require current owner and usable workspace; redemption separately verifies recipient evidence and the current issuing owner grant. Accepted invitations cannot be revoked to remove membership.

parameters.description: Current authority precedes lookup. Redemption lookup is caller+operation+key, before any workspace/target partition.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

200.description: Current safe metadata/current resulting membership after authorization. No token is present on any idempotent retry.

400.description: Fixed safe control Error; do not expose token/recipient/identity/provider details.

401.description: Fixed safe control Error; do not expose token/recipient/identity/provider details.

X-Authentication-Action.description: reauthenticate only for insufficiently recent actual session authentication; absent for invalid/missing/revoked sessions.

403.description: Fixed safe control Error; do not expose token/recipient/identity/provider details.

404.description: Resource unavailable. Unknown token, wrong recipient, revoked grant and invalid inviter authority share a fixed nonenumerating response.

409.description: Fixed safe control Error; do not expose token/recipient/identity/provider details.

422.description: Fixed safe control Error; do not expose token/recipient/identity/provider details.

429.description: Generic temporarily_unavailable Error with retryable=true; required distributed request-rate enforcement is not implemented by these contracts.

Retry-After.description: Bounded server delay independent of invitation existence.

503.description: Fixed safe control Error; do not expose token/recipient/identity/provider details.

post.x-implementation-status: contract only; handlers/SQL/verification/rate limiting are not implemented
